svg.title: Why the diagonal stays in FP32
svg.desc: A 2 by 2 example proved in Lean. Diagonal-inclusive 4-bit rounding drives condition number above 321, while diagonal-split 4-bit recovers the exact factor.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, 'Liberation Sans', sans-serif

svg.text: For any matrix size, a lower-triangular G with positive diagonals makes GᵀG positive definite,

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, 'Liberation Sans', sans-serif

svg.text: regardless of how the 4-bit off-diagonals round. Round any diagonal entry to zero and GᵀG turns singular.
